headline: Aurobindo Pharma Limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition - AUROPHARMA: Aurobindo Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange about incorporation of a new wholly owned subsidiary by the name of  Avogent Lifesciences Private Limited  in India by Apitoria Pharma Private Limited, a wholly…
detail: Acquisition - AUROPHARMA: Aurobindo Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange about incorporation of a new wholly owned subsidiary by the name of  Avogent Lifesciences Private Limited  in India by Apitoria Pharma Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company.
